products.name: Florence
flavorNotes: Balanced and smooth note of fruit, Choclate and caramel , bright acidity and pleasant ,clean after taste Medium body
products.description: Colombian coffee represents a prestigious denomination reserved for 100% Arabica specialty coffee produced in Colombia's renowned coffee-growing regions. Known for its sweet, creamy notes with subtle hints of chocolate, this coffee delivers a refined and balanced flavor profile. To qualify as "Café de Colombia," the coffee must be of premium quality, exclusively sourced from Colombia’s designated coffee-growing zones. It is cultivated at high altitudes, often exceeding 2,000 meters above sea level, where unique climate conditions contribute to its exceptional taste and aroma.

products.name: Roma
flavorNotes: cane sugar , and red berry and citric after taste medium body
products.description: Crafted from premium Colombian Medellín Supremo beans, this espresso offers a rich, aromatic experience with a distinct elegance. With a smooth body and well-balanced profile, it delivers delightful light notes of cocoa and cream. The result is a coffee that’s full of character, yet approachable—perfect for any time of day. Whether enjoyed as a classic espresso or in your favorite coffee beverage, this blend brings a touch of luxury to every cup.

products.name: Milan
products.description: A coffee that’s more than just a moment of refreshment; it’s an experience for the senses. Rich and aromatic, Palermo Blend embodies the soul of Sicilian coffee with a perfect balance of strength and finesse. Bold yet delicate, robust yet fragrant, this blend is your ideal companion at any time of day. It’s not just about energy—it’s about finding a moment of calm and well-being, enveloped in the comforting warmth and inviting aroma of Milan’s finest coffee.

products.name: Venice
products.description: Sourced from the classy region of latin America, this high-end specialty coffee is decaffeinated using the natural Mountain Water Process, ensuring a clean and chemical-free cup. Known for its rich, nutty sweetness and smooth, low acidity, this decaf offers the classic taste of tropical climate—delightful bittersweet notes paired with hints of chocolate and roasted nuts. Whether you're seeking a relaxing cup or a rich, satisfying brew, this decaf provides all the flavor without the caffeine.

products.name: Verona Ethipian Kaffa Tega specialty Coffee Beans
flavorNotes: Floral , Sweet Vanilla , Dried Apricot , Chocolate , Smooth Acidity , Tea-Like / Honey Body
products.description:
A distinguished offering from Kaffa Tega, Ethiopia, this specialty-grade Verona coffee is cultivated at elevations between 1830 and 1890 masl, and graded 86.5+ for its exceptional quality. Processed using the washed method and roasted to a medium level, it preserves the Gesha variety’s delicate, floral essence.

In the cup, Verona reveals a captivating combination of floral notes, sweet vanilla, dried apricot, and hints of chocolate, supported by a gentle smooth acidity and a tea-like, honeyed body. This elegant profile is ideal for filter brewing and those who appreciate complexity with balance.

products.name: Florance speciality Coffee Beans
flavorNotes: Hazelnuts , Black cherry , chocolate with sweet finish , delicate acidity low , smooth body
products.description:
Sourced from the highlands of Tamara, Colombia, Florance is a specialty-grade Arabica coffee grown at 1400 masl and graded 87+, reflecting its refined and consistent quality. With a washed process and medium roast, it delivers a balanced and aromatic experience.

In every cup, you’ll find inviting notes of hazelnuts, black cherry, and chocolate, complemented by a sweet finish, low delicate acidity, and a smooth, rounded body. This coffee is perfect for those seeking elegance, clarity, and a touch of sweetness in every brew — ideal for pour-over, French press, or espresso.

products.name: GESHA Ethiopian Chaka Specialty Coffee Beans
flavorNotes: Citrus Fruits , Cranberry , Floral , green apple , Guava , lemon malic acid , grape fruit, orange , red fruit , stone fruit , sweet & sugary , tart cherry
products.description:
Sourced from the high-altitude regions of Ethiopia, this exceptional GESHA variety coffee undergoes a natural anaerobic process that unlocks a highly expressive and aromatic cup. Grown at elevations ranging from 1911 to 2069 masl, it is graded 87, reflecting its premium specialty status.

This medium roast reveals an intricate flavor profile: bright citrus fruits, cranberry, and floral notes, layered with green apple, guava, and grapefruit. A sweet and sugary core is balanced by a touch of lemon malic acidity, orange zest, red and stone fruits, and finishes with a clean hint of tart cherry.

An ideal choice for filter or slow-brew enthusiasts seeking a complex, fruit-forward experience with exceptional clarity and depth.

products.name: Colombia Coffee Huila Specialty Coffee Beans
flavorNotes: Dried Apricot , Floral , Black Plum , with delicate acidity and round smooth body
products.description:
Sourced from the high-altitude farms of Huila, Colombia, this 87-grade specialty Arabica is grown at 1900 masl and naturally processed to preserve its full aromatic range.

The medium roast profile brings out vibrant layers of dried apricot, floral complexity, and black plum, with a delicate acidity and smooth, rounded body that make each cup elegant and satisfying. Ideal for manual brewing methods, this coffee is a perfect reflection of Colombia’s renowned coffee heritage.

products.name: Brazil Santos Specialty Coffee
flavorNotes: Roasted Hazelnut, Sugar Cane Walnut With Low Acidity And Creamy Body
products.description:
Sourced from the highlands of Brazil, this specialty coffee showcases the very best of natural-process Arabica, grown at 1050 meters above sea level and graded 85+ for its exceptional quality. The cup reveals an elegant mix of roasted hazelnut, sugarcane sweetness, and walnut, delivering a mellow, low-acidity profile with a luxuriously creamy body.

Perfectly suited for filter or espresso, Brazil Santos offers a smooth, approachable flavor that’s both comforting and refined — a true classic in specialty coffee.

products.name: Guatemala AA SHB Specialty Coffee
flavorNotes: Chocolate, Brown Sugar, Prune Toffee With Long Nutty Finish, Medium To Low Acidity With Full Body
products.description:
From the high-altitude regions of Guatemala, this AA SHB (Strictly Hard Bean) specialty coffee is grown at 1350 masl and graded 86, signifying its superior quality and well-balanced profile. Carefully washed and medium roasted, it offers a flavorful and full-bodied experience.

In the cup, expect rich notes of chocolate, brown sugar, and prune toffee, accompanied by a long nutty finish. The coffee presents a medium to low acidity, making it smooth yet vibrant, and ideal for those who enjoy structured depth without overwhelming brightness.

Perfect for espresso or immersion brews, this Guatemalan gem delivers both comfort and complexity in every sip.

products.name: Nicaragua Buenos Aires Specialty Coffee
flavorNotes: Chocolate, Walnut, Brown Sugar With Low Acidity And Full Creamy Body
products.description:
Grown at altitudes ranging from 1200 to 1700 masl in the rich volcanic soils of Nicaragua, this specialty-grade coffee is carefully washed and medium roasted to preserve its natural sweetness and depth. With a cupping score of 86.75, this coffee delivers a comforting yet refined profile.

Expect layered flavors of chocolate, toasted walnut, and brown sugar, balanced by low acidity and a full, creamy body. It’s a smooth and indulgent cup that appeals to both casual drinkers and specialty coffee enthusiasts, perfect for espresso or pour-over brewing methods.

products.name: Torino Espresso Roasted Coffee Beans
flavorNotes: Cream, caramel, and roasted hazelnut,subtle hints of tobacco and pink pepper
products.description:
ourced from the high mountains of Peru. Cultivated at altitudes ranging from 1200 to 1800 meters above sea level, these beans are known for their exceptional size and vibrant color, ensuring a cup of coffee that is both aromatic and comforting.

This medium dark roast, crafted in the Italian style, offers an enticing cocoa aroma that is both pleasant and inviting. Experience a smooth flavor profile with delightful notes of cream, caramel, and roasted hazelnut. The velvety finish reveals subtle hints of tobacco and pink pepper, creating a well-balanced cup with a medium density body.

products.name: Aroma Espresso Roasted Coffee Beans
flavorNotes: pleasant taste of nuts and pralines, with long lasting and pleasant after taste of cereals
products.description:
Aroma is a well-balanced and round crafted cuvee. With its medium roast, low bitterness, but slightly higher acidity this blend will emanate a pleasant taste of nuts and pralines, with long lasting and pleasant after taste of cereals. Recommended for milk-based coffee and espresso.

Aroma is a lavishly engineered blend, made with some of best coffee origins in the world, and roasted to perfection to allow all it sent to express their best at every sip.

products.name: Afandi Turkish Coffee
products.description:
Afandi is a traditional-style Turkish coffee made from a curated blend of 100% Arabica beans sourced from select origins. Roasted to a smooth medium level, it delivers a refined balance between richness and aroma, ideal for lovers of classic, finely ground Turkish brews.

This blend is crafted to produce a full-bodied cup with velvety texture, gentle bitterness, and a lingering finish — perfect for moments of calm, conversation, or cultural rituals. Whether served plain or with sugar, Afandi evokes the charm and depth of authentic Turkish coffee traditions.

products.name: Afandi Turkish Coffee With Cardamom
products.description:
Crafted in the traditional style, Afandi Turkish Coffee with Cardamom blends finely ground 100% Arabica beans with the warm, aromatic spice of natural cardamom. Sourced from a mixed blend of origins and roasted to a medium level, this coffee delivers a timeless fusion of depth and fragrance.

Rich, smooth, and deeply satisfying, each cup carries the comforting body of Turkish coffee enhanced by the herbal, slightly citrusy note of cardamom. Perfect for ceremonial coffee moments or everyday indulgence, this blend offers a sensory journey rooted in culture and flavor.

This blend is crafted to produce a full-bodied cup with velvety texture, gentle bitterness, and a lingering finish — perfect for moments of calm, conversation, or cultural rituals. Whether served plain or with sugar, Afandi evokes the charm and depth of authentic Turkish coffee traditions.

The cup is gentle yet flavorful, with a balanced body and soft finish that pairs beautifully with or without cardamom. Ideal for daily rituals and gatherings, it offers an authentic taste experience rooted in heritage and warmth.
